question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: A smoke-colored object or vision is to be contemplated
The contemplation is to be done always
The result is the power to shake the triple world
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored vision, one can shake the triple world
uncertainties: The exact object that is smoke-colored is not explicitly stated
plain_english: O beloved, always contemplating what is smoke-colored, one can shake the triple world.
